mapper.select:
SELECT uc.conversation_id AS conversationId, uc.pinned, uc.mute, uc.last_read_seq AS lastReadSeq, uc.unread_count AS unreadCount, uc.list_cursor_seq AS listCursorSeq, uc.updated_at AS updatedAt,
c.type AS conversationType, c.name AS conversationName, c.avatar AS conversationAvatar, c.last_msg_id AS lastMsgId, c.last_seq AS lastSeq FROM user_conversation uc JOIN conversations c ON c.id = uc.conversation_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.pinned DESC, uc.list_cursor_seq DESC, uc.conversation_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_conversation ( user_id, conversation_id, pinned, mute, last_read_seq, unread_count, list_cursor_seq, updated_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{conversationId}, 0, 0, #{lastReadSeq}, 0, #{listCursorSeq}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedAt} )
